newsitem.title: USA: Racotek trims Q4 loss as revenues climb.
newsitem.headline: Racotek trims Q4 loss as revenues climb.

text.p: Racotek Inc said Wednesday it posted a net loss of $1.8 million in the fourth quarter ended December 31, compared to a loss of $3.7 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
The company said year-ago figure included a one-time charge of $742,000 related to its purchase of certain assets and technologies from Business Partner Solutions Inc.
Racotek, which provides mobile data communications software and services, reported total revenues of $1.75 million in the period, versus $1.61 million one year ago.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Wednesday at 4-1/8.
